Commentary.Commentary: 303 is a stiff target! The pitch is a good one to bat on but it is a little sluggish. Australia will have to bat really well, they need their openers to fire. England will back themselves to defend this. An exciting second essay awaits.

The Aussie bowling was good initially but faded as the game went on. Hazlewood and Cummins were really poor, even though the latter got Bairstow towards the end. Starc also took a pounding as the game progressed. Zampa was the only one who bowled his 10 overs decently. Overall though the Australians will be pretty disappointed after the start they got off too, with the ball.

An excellent batting display from England on the back of a brilliant ton from Jonny Bairstow and some handy innings from Billings and Woakes. However, it was not the best of starts for them after they elected to bat. They lost two on the first two balls of the game. They later on were put in further trouble at 4 for 96. An excellent 114-run partnership then between Billings and Bairstow took them to safer shores. Australia did fight back by getting the two in quick succession but Woakes and Curran then continued the good work. Chris showed what he is capable with the bat as he stroked a half ton and took his side over 300.
Woakes is down the track again, works this shortish ball on the on side for a couple. ENGLAND FINISH ON 302/7.
Woakes gets to his fifty with a couple, excellent knock from him. He pulls this short length delivery to mid-wicket and collects a couple.
FOUR! Excellent batting this from Woakes! Full and outside off, Woakes uses the pace of the bowler and guides this past point and bags a boundary.

Excellent fielding from Labuschagne at deep point, keeps it down to two. Woakes advances and lofts this good length delivery to deep point where Marnus puts in a good dive to contain the ball. Just the couple there.
Down the track comes Woakes. It is a length ball on top of the stumps, Woakes looks to cut but misses it altogether.

FOUR! Fanstastic, fantastic from Chris Woakes! Woakes shuffled across and looked to play it on the on side but adjusts himself well towards the end and dinked it on the off side. He gets it to the third man region and collects a boundary.
Starc bowls a short length delivery, Rashid, again, shuffled to his right and looked to play it on the leg side. He though misses and the ball goes over his head to the keeper.
Full and outside off, Woakes hits this past covers for one. The batters pondered for the second but settle for the one.
Shuffles across again but this time he can only work this to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Just the single.
SIX! Amazing shot from Rashid there and he moves to double figures with that! Rashid shuffles across and launches this full length ball over deep backward square leg for six runs.
In the air...but hit safely! Full and outside off, Woakes looked to work that over cover but gets a thick outside edge. It though falls safely behind point and a single is taken.
On middle, Woakes lofts this over mid-wicket and bags a couple as the fielder in the deep cuts it off.
Full and on off, Woakes strikes it firmly past Hazlewood and collects a single.
Fullish ball outside off, Adil cuts this towards point and gets to the other end quickly.
This time he sneaks in a couple as he works this off his pads to mid-wicket for two.
Rashid gives room on the off side and looked to heave this over covers. But Hazlewood follows him with a good length delivery. Rashid misses.
Excellent bowling from Hazlewood! A yorker length delivery around off, Rashid looked to dig that out but he fails to do so.
Shortish and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Yorker outside off, Rashid attempts to put bat on ball but misses out.
Woakes opens the face of his bat and guides this to third man for one.
FOUR! Excellent batting from Woakes! Full and on off, missing the yorker, Starc. Woakes lifts this uppishly over covers and gets a boundary.
Rashid is off the mark. Gets the fuller ball past mid on towards long on for a single.
Adil Rashid walks out to the crease now.

OUT! TIMBER! This is an excellent comeback from Starc, having conceded a six off the first ball! Tom Curran departs after a well made 19 though. Yorker length delivery on middle, Curran backs to the leg side a bit and looked to steer that towards third man. He though misses and the ball crashes into his stumps. Starc, not doing any fancy stuff here, just the basic yorker and he gets his man.
SIX! Smeared away, on the leg side! Full and on middle, Curran lofts this high and over the deep mid-wicket region for six runs.
Short length ball, Curran pulls it to deep fine leg. The batters take three as Starc gives chase and keeps it out. Starc seems to have fallen over his arm in the process but luckily is back up again.
Woakes drives this fuller ball through covers for a single.

FOUR! This is good intelligent batting from Woakes here! On a length outside off, Woakes backs away to the leg side and lifts this over backward point, who was inside the circle. It goes over the fielder and to the deep for a boundary.
A low full toss outside off, Woakes misses out there, probably expecting the yorker. He looks to slash hard at that but fails to connect.
Full and on off, driven to long on. A single.
WIDE! Bowls a length ball down the leg side. Wide signalled straightaway.
Fullish and on off, Woakes strikes that back to Hazlewood who fails to hold on to it. It goes off his hands to the on side and a single is stolen.
A single to finish as this fullish ball is pushed past cover for one.
Swing and a miss! Shortish and outside off, Woakes looked to pull that to deep square leg but he misses by a mile!
Full length delivery outside off, Curran looked to drive that past covers but it takes a thick outside edge and goes uppishly towards deep backward point. A single taken.
Excellent slower ball from Starc! Right in the blockhole outside off, Curran looked to dig it out but fails to do so.
Full and on middle, Curran can only dig it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle and leg, Woakes chips this uppishly but safely towards long on. The batsmen take a single.
Mitchell Starc is back in the attack. Can he pick up some wickets to curtail the scoring rate?
On the pads, an attempted flick by Woakes does not connect. It comes off his pads to fine leg and a leg bye is taken.
WIDE! Back of a length delivery down the leg side. Wide called as Woakes leaves that one.
Shortish length delivery, Curran pulls but straight to deep square leg. A single.
Woakes pulls to the shorter one again but this time he will only get a single.
Short length delivery, pulled to fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! Straight down the ground, safest place to go! Full and on the stumps, Woakes drives this back past Marsh and gets it to the boundary as both long on and long off were well wide.
Full and on middle and leg, Woakes looked to flick that on the leg side but ends up getting a leading edge. The ball falls safely on the off side though.
Mitchell Marsh is back in the attack. 5-0-16-0 are his numbers.
On middle, Curran keeps it out on the leg side off his back foot.
A couple shouts Curran as he plays this and he will get the same. Fullish and outside off, Curran knocks this past covers for a couple.
Woakes opens the face of his blade and guides this good length delivery to third man for one.
FOUR! With the wind and to the short boundary! Full and on middle, Woakes launches this over short mid-wicket and the ball races away to the deep for a boundary.
Full and on off, driven to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Woakes steers this to third man and a couple is taken.
Flatter ball outside off, Curran works this towards point off his back foot. Excellent finish from Zampa, he has been terrific in this match!

Good bowling from Zampa here! The legbreak, pitches on middle and spins away. Gets the outside edge of Curran's bat as he looked to defend that one. Goes off the edge towards third man and the batters will sneak in a couple.
On the shorter side on middle and leg, worked to short fine leg for one. The batters wanted two but Starc was quick there to get to the ball and just the single.
Flatter on the off pole, Curran goes back and works this towards mid-wicket. He will get a single.
Adam tosses this outside off, Woakes prods forward and nudges this towards mid off. A single.
An awkward shuffle across from Curran. He plays this flatter ball towards mid-wicket for one.
A single and Curran is off the mark. He works this good length delivery to the leg side and takes a single.
Back of a length ball on off and middle, Curran defends it back on to the ground.
Fullish and on the off stump line, Curran defends it back from within his crease.
Fullish and outside off this time, Curran cuts towards point.
Back of a length delivery on off and middle, defended back.
Tom Curran walks out to bat now.

OUT! BOWLED! Ohhh...What has happened here? An excellent nip-backer from Cummins! Jonny Bairstow is himself at disbelief with the way it came back in! Cummins takes a big wicket just when Australia needed it. Full length delivery on off, Bairstow looked to guide that towards third man but the ball nips back in after pitching and goes past the gate and crashes into the off pole. An enchanting delivery from Cummins, to say the least.
Powerplay 2 time! Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
On middle, Bairstow tucks this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, Woakes nudges this towards point.
Flatter ball on the off stump, Bairstow rocks back and pushes this past mid on for a single.
Hard drive by Bairstow there! Tossed up on the stumps, Jonny drives this hard back to Zampa, who looked to stop it but the ball goes through and hits the stumps at the other end.
Flatter and outside off, cut but straight to point.
Adam loops this full and around off, Woakes taps it towards mid off and takes a quick single.
On off, worked to point for a dot.
Full and around off, Woakes works this to mid-wicket and takes a single off the fifth ball.
Fourth dot ball in a row! Woakes goes back and pushes this short ball to the off side for another dot.
Shortish again, Woakes punches yet again, this time to backward point. Third dot on the trot.
Shortish length ball on top of off, Woakes rocks back and punches this ball to the off side.
On a length outside off, Woakes cuts but finds point.
FOUR! Looped up full and outside off, Bairstow leans into it and creams this through covers for a boundary.
The legbreak. Pitches on off and spins away, Jonny reads it well. Lets it through.
Woakes is off the mark. Looped up outside off, he drives this towards wide mid off for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! The partnership is finally broken and Billings would be disappointed with himself for that! It is a shot which Billings plays often and unfortunately for him, this time around, it has cost him his wicket! Loopy ball on off, Sam gets to his knees and reverse sweeps at this one. It goes uppishly though and straight down the throat of Mitchell Marsh at backward point who holds on to it safely. Australia have got the wicket they badly needed.
Full and on middle, Bairstow comes down the track and pushes this to long on for a single.
Adam floats this full on off, Sam works this to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Muscled that one did Bairstow! Full and on off, he drives this firmly past mid off, who had no chance to cut it off. It goes to the long off fence for four.
SIX! Shot, super shot! What a way to bring up your hundred! Take a bow, Jonny Bairstow! Full and on middle, Bairstow lifts this nonchalantly over deep square leg for six.
Good length delivery outside off, Bairstow pushes this towards point.
Shortish and on middle and leg, Billings tucks this behind square on the leg side for one.
Good length delivery around off, Bairstow drives this past extra cover this time, for a single.
On off, driven to extra cover for a dot.
Full on middle, Jonny drives this to long on for one.
Adam bowls a flatter one outside off, Billings knocks this on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Struck hard and struck for four! Flatter on off, Billings powers this to cow corner for a boundary off his backfoot.

On the shorter side, Billings pulls this to deep square leg and gets a couple. He moves to his half ton with that as well. Excellent batting. A hundred in the first match and a 50 now. He is not done yet though.
On off, defended to the off side for a dot.

FOUR! It was just wide of Warner at mid-wicket! Floats a fuller one on middle, Billings puts the dancing shoes on, advances and chips this uppishly but to the left of Warner at mid-wicket. The ball goes into the fence off the bounce.
Two dots to end but a good over for England. Full and on off, it is pushed to mid off.
BEATEN! Full and outside off, JB looks to go over covers but misses.
Shorter and around off, it is pushed through covers for one.
A good shot again but no runs! Fuller and on middle, it is whipped nicely but to mid-wicket.

SIX! All the way! Innovation from Billings! Absolutely brilliant. He has probably decided to step on the paddle. It is full and on middle, he brings out the paddle scoop, it is right off the middle and goes over the fine leg fence.
On middle, Billings looks to heave it but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish and on middle, Bairstow drives it back to Starc.
Full and on middle, Sam plays this to deep mid-wicket and collects a single.
On the pads again, Jonny glances this towards fine leg this time, for a single.
Full and on the pads, Bairstow works this towards mid-wicket.
Nothing much off the free hit though! Short length ball, Bairstow pulls this towards deep square leg for a couple.

NO BALL! No ball has been called as Marsh indavertently hit the stumps at the non-striker's end as he completed his run-up. This was a fullish ball outside off, Sam worked that behind point for one. Free hit coming up!
On middle, worked towards wide mid on for a single.

DRINKS! A good passage of play this, for England. They have stemmed the loss of wickets while also trying to up the scoring rate. Bairstow is close to getting his ton while Billings looks in really good touch as well. England would definitely be looking at 300 here provided these two can stay on for a while. Let's see how it pans out after the break...
Short length ball on top of middle and leg, Billings swivels and looks to pull. He though fails to connect. A very mild appeal from the keeper for a caught behind but nothing doing says the umpire.
SIX! He has hit that and it has gone miles! Full and on off and middle, Sam lofts this over deep square leg for a biggie.

Good save from Cummins there, but he is not happy that he allowed an extra run to be taken. Short length delivery, Sam pulls towards deep square leg where Cummins puts in the dive. A couple taken after Cummins failed to collect the ball quickly after stopping it initially.
Full and on middle, a strong straight drive from Billings. It hits the stumps at the other end and goes to the leg side off the deflection.
Billings drives the full ball but finds the man at mid on.
On a good length outside off, steered to third man for a single.
Mitchell Starc is back in the attack. His figures are 5-0-30-2.
Clever bowling from Marsh! A slower bouncer outside off, Billings lets it go. He though is livid himself later on.
Full and on the off pole, Billings keeps it out on the leg side.
WIDE! Short length delivery down the leg side. Wide called.
This time he connects on the pull. It goes to deep forward square leg and the batters take a couple.
Swing and a miss! On a length down the leg side, Billings advances down the pitch and looked to pull at it but misses it altogether.

A quick single here! Fullish and on off, Bairstow taps it to his right on the off side and takes a single. Marsh runs in and flicks it off his boots to the striker's end but Billings was comfortably home.
On middle, Bairstow clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish and on middle and leg, Billings comes down and looks to play at it but he misses. He gets hit around the box.
Good length ball outside off, Jonny guides this towards third man. A single taken.
On off, driven towards cover.

Full and swinging into the pads, an attempted glance by Bairstow but he misses and it comes off his pads. It goes to short mid-wicket who picks up and attemps a throw at the non-striker's end as Billings strayed out. Sam though makes it back in safely.
This time Hazlewood attacks the stumps, Jonny is upto the task. Fends it out.
Full and around off, Bairstow drives but finds mid off.
Fullish and on the stumps, defended to the on side.
WIDE! A bouncer, well outside off and way over the batsman's height. Wide called by the umpire.
Fullish and on off, Sam blocks it out to covers.
Fuller and on the pads, Bairstow looks to clips it towards short fine leg. It though comes off his pads and goes to the fielder there. A leg bye is taken.
On middle and leg, Bairstow flicks but finds mid-wicket. Another dot.
On the stumps, Bairstow defends it back on to the track.
Fullish and outside off, cut away past point. A single.
Mitchell Marsh is back in the attack.
A single to finish as Billings tucks this full length delivery to fine leg for one.
Good length delivery around off, Billings looked to pull at it but misses it altogether. It was not that short to be pulled at though!
Full and outside off, Billings finds the extra cover fielder on the drive.
Billings looks to cut the length ball but gets a bottom edge which goes back to Carey.
Good length ball outside off, Jonny steers this towards third man for one.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Billings tucks this to the on side for a single. Leg bye called by the umpire, as he reckons it came off the pads.
On the pads, clipped to the leg side for a dot.
Another couple as this is swept towards long leg for a brace.
WIDE! Maxwell bowls a shorter one down the leg side. Bairstow does not play at it. Wided.
Floats a fuller one on the pads, Bairstow sweeps towards Zampa at fine leg for two.
A stifled appeal for LBW but the umpire reckons it came off the bat. Flatter down the leg side, Billings gets down and tucks this away behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! The reverse sweep is out! Floated full on middle and leg, Billings reverse sweeps that away to the deep point region and bags a boundary.
Full on middle, Billings looked to defend that back on to the pitch but gets an inside edge. It goes to square leg for a dot.
Good length ball on the stumps, Bairstow looked to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On the pads, Sam works this to short fine leg. A single.
Fullish and outside off, Billings drives but straight to extra cover.
Full and on off, blocked to the off side.

Another appeal for LBW from Cummins but pretty much turned down for the same reason. Fullish and on middle and leg, gets Billings' pads as he looked to fend that. Another appeal but to no avail, again. Finch, not interested in reviewing this one as well.

An appeal for LBW from Cummins but turned down by the umpire. Too straight and down the leg side that. Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, gets the pads of Bairstow as he looked to play at it. Cummins appeals but to no avail. The ball goes off the deflection to the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Another single to end as this is worked through mid-wicket.
A little bit of turn! It is on middle and it spins into the pads. Bairstow looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
WIDE! Down the leg side, left alone.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
One more single! On middle, it is flicked with the turn through mid-wicket.
Billings skips down the track and works it through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A single to end as this is pushed through covers.
A couple! Angled into the pads, Jonny works it with soft hands through square leg and takes two.
A slower one on middle, Bairstow works it towards mid-wicket.
BEATEN! This was just behind the driving length. It is fuller and outside off. JB goes after it but misses.
Fuller and on off, Billings strokes it wide of mid off for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Maxwell flights this on the stumps, Bairstow blocks it out for a dot.
On the pads, Bairstow flicks it but finds the man at short fine leg. A dot delivery.
Flatter again, on the leg pole, Billings goes back and drives this past mid on for one.
Flatter ball on the stumps, Bairstow drives it past mid on for a single.
This one is flatter, he rocks back and plays this past the diving Warner at square leg for a single.
Billings advances and works this full ball to short mid-wicket for a dot.
Short length ball just outside off, Bairstow sways away from the line.
Quick running and a couple! Good length delivery outside off, Bairstow cuts this behind point. He comes back quickly for the second as the throw is in at the striker's end. Good running from the two!
FOUR! Jonny Bairstow has looked in good touch today! Fullish and outside off, he stretches and works that past covers for a boundary.
Full and outside off this time, a firm drive by Bairstow but he finds Finch at extra cover.
Fuller and on the stumps, Bairstow pushes it back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off, Sam guides this towards third man for a single.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end now, replacing Adam Zampa.
Flatter ball on the pads, Bairstow goes back and tucks this to short fine leg for a dot.
Flatter outside off, Billings pushes this towards covers for one.
On the pads, Bairstow tucks this behind square on the leg side for a single.
This time he comes down the track and nudges this flatter ball towards mid-wicket. A single.
On the shorter side again, on leg. Sam keeps it out.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket off the back foot for a single.
Another single to end a good over for JB. He works it through mid-wicket for one.
Now he does hit it past the bowler towards mid on for one.
Billings skips down the track and works it to the right of the bowler who stops it.
Now cleverly nudges it around the corner and takes one.
FOUR! Makes excellent use of the feet here. He skips down and gets to the pitch of the ball. Whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good running! On middle, this is worked with soft hands through square leg and two runs are taken.
FOUR! And that brings the 100 for England as well! Shortish ball outside off, Billings cuts that behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Short length ball, pulled away to deep backward square leg for one.
Bairstow too drives the fuller one back but straight to Starc who stops it this time around.
Full and on middle, Billings drives it back past Starc towards long on for a single.
BEATEN! Length delivery around off, Billings looked to poke at it off his front foot, but misses completely.
On off, Billings defends it out.
Can Starc bag a couple more wickets here?

NOT OUT! Australia thought that the ball hit the pad first but replays confirmed otherwise and hence they lose the review! Flatter ball on middle, Bairstow goes back and defends that out towards backward point. Zampa thinks it came off the pads and hence appeals for a LBW. He convinces Finch to take the review and the same is taken. But to their dismay, it came off the bat.
Review time! Finch has taken a review for LBW against Jonny Bairstow. Replays roll in and the ball has clearly hit the bat, so nothing from the review then.
Flatter ball on middle, Bairstow works this on the leg side off his back foot.
Full on middle, Bairstow leans forward and blocks that out.
Sam is off the mark, courtesy a misfield. Fuller on middle, Sam works this towards mid off where the fielder fumbles and allows a single to be taken.
On middle, Sam Billings defends it back.
Sam Billings walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just chipped it to extra cover! Big wicket this as Buttler was looking to settle himself in and play the big shots! Zampa flights a slower one around off, Buttler gave himself room on the off side and drove at it uppishly. It went to the left of Finch at extra cover who does well to hold on to that. England have lost their fourth and are crumbling here.
FOUR! LEG BYES! Short and on the body, Bairstow looks to pull but misses. It hits his arm and goes down to the fine leg fence.
A bumper! The batter does well to duck under it.
One more delivery on middle, Bairstow works it to mid on again.
On middle, fuller, it is flicked to mid on.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Angled into the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side for two.
Zampa flights this around off, Bairstow drives it towards mid off for one.
Full and on off, driven to mid on. A dot this time though.
Slower through the air outside off, Buttler prods forward and drives that towards long off for a single.
Flatter again, on off. Bairstow rocks back and works this to mid-wicket. Another single.
Flatter ball outside off, Buttler cuts this towards deep point for one.
On off, Bairstow lunges forward and drives this to long off for a single.

DRINKS! Australia started off exceedingly well with 2 early wickets. England did well to stage a recovery from there but ended up losing Morgan once Zampa was brought into the attack. Now, Bairstow and Buttler are attempting another recovery of sorts and have done well so far! Can they continue or will Australia strike again? We'll find out after Drinks!
Length ball outside off, Bairstow plays this to deep point and takes one. He will keep strike in the next over.

FOUR! It was tickled away fine and Bairstow gets to his fifty! A crucial knock in the context of the circumstances. Shortish length ball, Bairstow swivels and pulls that towards fine leg for a boundary.
Full on the stumps, Bairstow wrists this on the leg side for a dot.
A quick single as Buttler works this fuller ball to Warner at covers. The throw comes in at the non-striker's end but Buttler was well in.
Fullish and on off, defended to the off side for a dot.
Full length delivery on the off pole, Buttler works that defensively towards mid on.
Full on middle, Bairstow keeps it out on the leg side.
Slower in the air outside off, worked towards long off for a single.
In the air...but safe and a couple! Flatter ball outside off, Buttler goes back and works this uppishly past point and gets a couple.
Missed out there, Buttler! A low full toss on the pads, he though is only able to turn it towards the fielder at short mid-wicket. A dot.
Flights this on the stumps, Buttler drives but straight to the man at cover.
Tosses this outside off, Bairstow leans and drives that towards long off for one.
On the pads, worked to square leg for a single.
WIDE! Again, just down the leg side, just down, but enough to be called a wide, feels the umpire. Cummins digs it short and just down the leg side. Bairstow ducks and lets it through. Wide called.
A quick single as Buttler taps this full length delivery to mid on and gets quickly to the other end.
Bumper on top of the stumps, an alert Buttler ducks under it.
Full on off and middle, Buttler defends it out on the on side.
Short length delivery, pulled away rather unconvincingly towards deep square leg. A single.
Fullish and on off, Bairstow defends it out towards short mid-wicket.
Flighted on middle, Buttler defends it out off his front foot.
Misses! Buttler looking to go down the ground on the off side, but misses completely. This was tossed up outside off, Buttler looked to drive fiercely at that but misses out.
Adam loops this on the stumps, Buttler prods forward and pokes that one out.
This time he leans forward and blocks the fuller one well.
Adam floats this on middle and leg, it kept low as well. Jos does well to keep it out.
Flatter ball outside off, Bairstow cuts that towards point and takes a single.
Full and around off, Buttler drives it on the off side but straight to the man at cover. A dot to finish for Cummins.
This time Bairstow is able to steer the length delivery, towards short third man though. A single taken nonetheless.
Outside off, Jonny does not fiddle with that one.
Full length delivery outside off, Bairstow drives but straight to cover.
Fullish and outside off, Bairstow looked to steer that towards third man. He though does not time it well, gets a bottom edge which goes to Carey behind.

BEATEN! Excellent stuff from Cummins! Bowls this on a length around off, Bairstow looked to block that but fails to get bat on ball. It was around the probing channel and therefore difficult to read and play at.
Pat Cummins is back in the attack.
Looped up on off, Jonny drives this to long off for a single. End of a successful over from Zampa.
Floats this on off, Bairstow drives but finds the man at cover.
On middle, Bairstow rocks back and defends this one out.
Buttler is off the mark! Works this floated delivery to deep extra cover for one.
Jos Buttler walks out to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The change of attack to spin has done the trick for Australia. Morgan picks out the tall man, Mitchell Starc at wide mid off with his shot! Loopy ball on the off pole, Morgan lifts this uppishly but straight to Starc there. He wanted to go up and over Starc but does not time it well and ends up holding out. He is very disappointed. He was looking good, had got off to a start but fails to covert it into something significant. Once again, Zampa provides the goods.
Floated on middle, Morgan drives that to mid off.
Full and on middle and leg, worked towards square leg for a single.

End of Powerplay 1! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Adam Zampa is on now. He has been brilliant in the series so far and he needs to break this stand.
On the pads, Bairstow tucks this away on the leg side for a single.
Full length delivery on the stumps, Jonny works this towards deep square leg and gets a couple.
Short and outside off, Bairstow sways away from the line of the delivery to let that one through.
FOUR! Just a gentle push and that raced away, it was the shorter part of the boundary as well! Full and outside off, Bairstow guides this deftly past backward point for four.
Good length delivery around off, Bairstow attemps to pull but misses to connect on this one. It was not that short for the pull though!
Good length delivery on middle, Morgan defends it back onto the pitch.
On middle, Morgan defends it out.
On a length on the pads, Morgan attempts to play at it but misses. It hits him on the top of his pads and deflects towards backward point for a dot.
Fullish again, this time on the stumps. Morgan just about keeps it out.
Fullish and outside off, Eoin blocks it out towards point.
FOUR! Just a gentle tickle, again! Full and on the pads, Morgan tickles that away behind square on the leg side, to fine leg and collects a boundary.
WIDE! Just down the leg side but the umpire deemed it a wide, too harsh maybe? Full and down the leg side, just a touch. Morgan attemps to glance but misses. Wide called immediately by the umpire.

FOUR! Tickeld away to the leg side and Hazlewood, cannot finish the over off without conceding a boundary! 50 up for England as well. Fullish on middle and leg, Bairstow tucks that away behind square on the leg side and the ball goes away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Good length ball in the channel outside off, Bairstow shoulders arms.
A single this time as Morgan flicks this fullish ball to square leg and gets to the other end.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards short mid-wicket for a dot.
A single as Bairstow closes the face of his bat to work this fuller ball towards mid-wicket for one.
Fullish ball outside off, Morgan guides this behind point for one.

Oooh..Lucky there, Bairstow! Inside edge and it goes just past his off pole to the keeper. Cummins bowls a good length delivery around off, Bairstow looked to pull at that. It though comes off the inner half and goes past his off pole to Carey.
On middle, Bairstow keeps this out to mid on for a dot.
FOUR! He is looking in belligerent form today, Bairstow! Full delivery outside off, he hammers this past covers and bags a boundary.
Length ball on middle and leg, Bairstow looked to turn that down to the leg side. He though misses and gets hit on the top of his pads.
SIX! Proper cricket this, strong shot from Bairstow! The first maximum for England. Short delivery, Bairstow pulls it firmly to the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Full length ball on off, Bairstow blocks it out.
Bairstow will get three as he pulls this short length ball to mid-wicket. Three taken by the batters.
Full length ball outside off, Eoin steers this towards third man for a single.

FOUR! A firm pull by Morgan and he gets a boundary. England are fighting back after the loss of those 2 wickets! Short length ball on top of the stumps, Morgan pulls this to deep fine leg for a boundary. Zampa there had no chance as the ball sped away to the ropes.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Morgan defends it to the leg side.
On off, Morgan defends it out.
FOUR! Morgan advances to Hazlewood and gets a boundary. Full length delivery way outside off, the English skipper skips down the track and guides this powerfully through point for four.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Bairstow defends it out. A good over for England.

FOUR! Top edge and Bairstow gets another boundary! Starc bowls a short length delivery, taking Bairstow by surprise. Jonny attempts a half-pull at that. The ball takes the top edge and goes over the keeper's head and into the fine leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Firmly struck by Bairstow! Full length ball on middle and leg, Bairstow powers this over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was a very confident shot. It flew off the bat.
BEATEN! The full ball did not swing as Bairstow would have expected there! Full and well outside off, Bairstow looks to drive but misses it completely.
Fullish on the off stump line, Bairstow blocks it to mid off.
Full and well outside off, Morgan leans in and drives that through covers. The fielder just about cuts it off before it reaches the boundary. The batsmen take three.
WIDE! Straying down the leg side again Starc. Morgan attemps to glance it away but misses and the umpire calls it a wide.
Decent finish from Hazlewood. Bowls a full length ball on the off stump, Bairstow defends it towards covers.
Bouncer from Hazlewood, Bairstow ducks under it.
Fullish and outside off, Bairstow works this to point for a dot.
Falls short! Full length delivery outside off, Bairstow hangs his bat out, looking to defend. It takes the outside edge and falls short of Aaron Finch at first slip.
FOUR! Crunched this one did Bairstow! Full and outside off, he cuts and cuts hard, it races away behind point and Jonny bags a boundary.
On off, Bairstow blocks it towards cover.
Digs in another short one, just outside off. Morgan looked to cut at that but it was too close to his body to do so. Misses completely.
Starc goes short this time, on top of the stumps. Morgan does well to keep that down. This is an excellent contest between the English skipper and Starc!
Back of a length this time, around middle and leg, Morgan jumps and keeps it out.
Misses! Short and wide outside off, asking to be hit. Morgan looks to cut at it but misses.
Full length ball on middle and leg, Morgan defends back.
Full length delivery around the off pole, Morgan works it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Fullish and down the leg side, Morgan lets it be. Wide called.
Good work from Carey again! It is on the pads, Bairstow looks to flick but it hits the pads and rolls to the left of Carey who dives and stops it.

FOUR! Creamed! Lovely from Bairstow. A shot which should give him a lot of confidence. It is slightly fuller and around off, no shape for Josh. Bairstow caresses it through covers for his first boundary.
On the shorter side, Bairstow picks the length early and pulls but to mid-wicket.
Slightly fuller and on middle, JB strokes it nicely to mid on.
Outside off, left alone nicely.
A good start by Hazlewood! It is a length ball around off, this one comes back in a little. Bairstow looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full length delivery around off, Morgan defends it back. An excellent start from Australia here! 4 runs and 2 wickets in the first over!
England are in deep trouble here after the first over! Also, this is a fresh surface which should be a lot better to bat on than the last two games so they will need a good score here.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl now.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! England are away and so is Morgan. Full delivery well outside off, Morgan leans in and drives this well through covers for a boundary.
Hat-trick ball then! Misses though! Full and down the leg side, Morgan looks to flick but misses. It clips his pads on the way to Carey. Good bowling though from Starc.
Eoin Morgan walks out to bat now, rather early!

OUT! LBW! 2 in 2 for Australia and Starc is on a hat-trick! Root pondered a little bit about whether to take the review but he pulls out in the end. Rightly so as that was plumb. Full length ball around off and middle, it pitches and comes in a little. Root looked to drive that on the up but misses, owing to the swing and gets rapped on the pads. Starc appeals and the umpire wastes no time in raising the finger. Root ponders on the review but bows out in the end and Australia are away in style here! Also, this is a very similar way to how Root got out in World Cup game against Australia, the one played during the group stage. He does struggle against the ball coming in a little early on in his innings and it was quite visible here. A poor series for Root comes to an end.
Joe Root walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gone, first ball, Starc strikes! Jason Roy shakes his head, a long walk off for him! Full length delivery outside off, Roy goes for the drive. He hits it uppishly and straight to backward point. Maxwell is the fielder there and he takes a good, neat catch. Australia draw first blood. Roy went a little too hard at that delivery. He was pushing at it ahead of his body and hence, he could not keep it down. Not a way you wanting to be playing early on in your innings.

The Australian players make their way out to the middle. Closely following them are the English openers, Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow. Mitchell Starc to start proceedings for Australia. It is a fresh pitch for this decider. The umpire calls play and we are off then!

Aaron Finch, Australia's skipper, says he would have batted first as well, given the dry wicket. He says that the first ten overs would be crucial. Finch states that the team is the same. On Steven Smith, he says that he is not cent-percent fit and therefore unfortunately misses out. On the 2nd ODI collapse, Finch admits that it was very tough, to let go a game slip away like that. He though wants to put that behind and looks forward to this game. Says that Archer bowled exceptionally last game and that there is a need to also develop a plan to counter England's batting, which he says the visitors have done for this game.

Eoin Morgan, England's captain, says England will bat first given the fact that he had a look at the wicket and with a short boundary, he has taken the decision to bat first. States that Sam Curran will make way for Mark Wood in the team, adding that it has been tough to leave him out but the team is looking for extra pace and hence the decision to bring in Wood. Morgan says that there is an eye on the next World Cup and hence the team selection and performance needs to be in line with the same. Lauds ECB for the way they have pulled off so many series this summer during these difficult times.

Australia (Unchanged Playing XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Marcus Stoinis, Marnus Labuschagne, Mitchell Marsh, Alex Carey (WK), Glenn Maxwell, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood, Adam Zampa.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (C), Jos Buttler (WK), Sam Billings, Chris Woakes, Tom Curran, Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer, Mark Wood (In place of Sam Curran).
Toss - England win the toss. THEY WILL BAT FIRST!

An Australian collapse in the second ODI and here we are then, for the decider of the series. What should have been a comfortable win for the visitors proved to be an arduous task and in the end, they lost it pretty badly. However, that is plenty of good news for us, fans, as what would have been a dead rubber now holds plenty of promise in terms of both the sides slugging out for one last time, the winner taking the glory. For Australia, a late decision on the availability of Steven Smith will be made, as per Langer, and the visitors would be counting on his comeback, given the middle-order collapse. England might largely play with an unchanged eleven and would be looking to go the whole hog for the win. Stay tuned for the toss and the teams' updates!
